hero.title: Find the plan that fits your budget
hero.subtitle: From free access to enterprise-scale deployment, Claude plans scale with how much you use it and how many people need it.
tiers.title: Plans and pricing
tiers.subtitle: Every plan includes the full Claude model family. Upgrade for more usage, more seats, or enterprise controls.
item-1.title: Free
item-1.body: Basic chat access to try Claude before you commit to a paid plan.
item-1.features: Chat with Claude on web and mobile
Access to the Claude model family
item-2.title: Pro
item-2.body: More usage plus Claude Code, Cowork, Design, and Science for everyday work.
item-2.features: Claude Code, Cowork, Design, Science included
item-3.title: Max
item-3.body: Higher usage ceilings for people who run Claude all day, every day.
item-4.title: Team
item-4.body: Shared workspace controls for teams of 2 to 150 people.
item-4.features: Centralized billing for the whole team
item-5.title: Enterprise
item-5.body: Compliance, audit logs, and dedicated support at organization scale.
item-5.features: SOC 2 Type II, SSO, SCIM provisioning
